text:
The `measure` proposal is clear, and I logged a "clear" line to `flags.jsonl`. `node Server/text-check.mjs` returned no flags on the task dir. `requirements.md` is a brief for agents, so there was no owner-facing text to rewrite. Its deliverable is one table and a closing one-liner.

I didn't open any page in a headless browser, because the task dir has no `page.js` and nothing the owner would see.
